start.text: (Karthik from the second floor, a rucksack half packed.) They're evacuating from Vidhana Soudha. The army. Buses, they're saying. We should go.

how.text: Walk to Cubbon. Twenty kilometres. People do it. (He doesn't believe it either.) I'm going. Soon.

camp.text: Told you. Vidhana Soudha. They say trucks will run from the Palace soon.

palace.text: Trucks. Every night. One of them is ours, if you'd only say so.

lalbagh.text: The trucks go from Yelahanka. That's all I'm going to say. Again.
